notes.title: OWOLD SPEEDRUN TOURNAMET
notes.content:
[b]OWOLD SPEEDRUNNERS[/b]

Our competition will end on [i]10/01/2025.[/i] The winner of the competition will have the right to get a name in the Game until the end of the next competition and will be able to announce their name to everyone.

Requirements for participating in the competition:

- You have purchased Owold (from Steam)
- You must send a proof video (from the beginning to the end of the game) that you have completed Owold
- Your Steam account name / Your real name
And there you have it! You are ready to have your name written in gold letters in Owold!!

The email you should send the videos to:

pixxallerstudios@gmail.com
